pages.lesson:
LESSON: BIBLE PATRIARCHS ABRAHAM

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Holy Bible
Topic 2.6: Bible Patriarchs Abraham

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Bible Patriarchs Abraham. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why was the name Abram changed?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. obey God’s instructions in his or her day-to-day life

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. obey God’s instructions in his or her day-to-day life
   In simple words: practise until you can obey God’s instructions in his or her day-to-day life. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Bible Patriarchs Abraham using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Bible Patriarchs Abraham in the examples.
2. Explain Bible Patriarchs Abraham to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Bible Patriarchs Abraham.
4. Show that you can: obey God’s instructions in his or her day-to-day life

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Bible Patriarchs Abraham using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Bible Patriarchs Abraham important for a Grade 4 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Sing the song about Abraham the father of faith,
2. Read Genesis 12:1-5 and retell the call of Abraham,
3. Role-play the call of Abraham,
4. Read Genesis 17:1-5 on the change of Abraham’s name,
5. Collaboration: the skill of teamwork is nurtured as learners role-play the call of Abraham.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why was the name Abram changed?
2. How did Abraham show obedience to God?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. obey God’s instructions in his or her day-to-day life

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
